text: Well, once, when I was fifteen, and spending the summer at the Heidelberg Institute in Germany. No, visiting professor. text: Uh, my mom had to fly back to Texas to help my dad because the house had slipped off the cinder blocks again.

speaker: Betty
text: It was tornado season. And it was an aluminum house. Anyway, the housekeeper in the faculty residence didn't speak any English, and when I finally managed to convince her I was sick, she said, "Macht es du ein Darmspulung?"

speaker: Betty
text: Based on what happened next, I assume it means, would you like an enema?

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, sweetie, I'll take care of you. What do you need?
